subs.name: Garnish
ingredients: ¼ cup good quality whiskey (Lee recommends Jefferson’s Reserve Very Old Bourbon.)

storyTitle: Chocolate Pecan Pie

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine all cocktail ingredients in a shaker tin, add ice, and shake vigorously. Strain and pour into a rocks glass. Gently add ice ball and garnish with lemon wheel skewered with brandied cherry.
ingredients: ¼ oz. Giffard Crème de Mûre
method: Combine all ingredients into mixing cup or other vessel and stir thoroughly. Pour into ice ball molds. Allow to freeze for 24 hours.
storyTitle: Eclipsed by None [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine all ingredients in shaker with ice. Shake vigorously. Strain into a tall glass or mason jar packed with ice. Garnish with jalapeño slices skewered in a lemon twist.
ingredients: 1 medium piece ginger root (about 1 oz.), diced
method: Bring jalapeños, ginger, and water to a boil in a medium saucepan. Reduce to simmer, add honey, and simmer for 10-12 minutes. Remove from heat and pass through a fine strainer. Pour into container and refrigerate. FROM THE SUMMER 2017 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Jalapeño Bizness [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine bourbon, grilled peach-black tea shrub, St. Germain, and salt in a shaker with ice. Shake well and strain using a fine sieve into a mason jar or other glass. Top with prosecco. Garnish with tarragon sprig and grilled peach slice.
method: Put all ingredients in a container and let sit overnight, shaking well periodically. Strain out bulk ingredients with a fine sieve. Keep refrigerated. FROM THE SUMMER 2017 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Rockaway Peach [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: In a footed glass or mug, add rum, Campari, vermouth, maple butter, and vanilla. Pour hot water on top and stir briskly until butter is dissolved and well integrated. Garnish with clove-studded half orange wheel.
method: Using a high-speed blender, whip all ingredients until smooth. Keeps in the refrigerator for up to 1 month.
storyTitle: Hot Buttered Toddy [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Stir all ingredients together in a mixing glass with ice. Strain over a large ice cube in a rocks glass. Garnish with a flamed orange twist. How to Flame an Orange TwistHolding the twist, take a match and lightly toast its oily outer peel. Then pinch the twist together over the flame to create a quick burst from the oils hitting the flame.
method: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to boil. Stir until sugar is completely dissolved. Remove from heat and let cool. Strain into a clean plastic quart container or glass bottle with a tight seal. Keeps in the refrigerator for up to two weeks.
storyTitle: Ojo Del Tigre [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine all ingredients into shaker tin, add ice, and shake vigorously. Strain into a coupe glass. Garnish with grapefruit twist around cinnamon stick.
method: Put water and cinnamon sticks in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce to simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in honey until incorporated and take off the heat. Let rest for 10 minutes and strain to remove cinnamon sticks. Place in a sealed container and refrigerate for up to 7 days.
storyTitle: Sombrero Rosado [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Chill a small rocks glass with ice, then discard the ice. Combine cocktail ingredients in a mixing glass with ice. Place crushed cinnamon bark on fire-resistant plate or surface and ignite. Cover with the chilled glass to catch the smoke. Stir cocktail in mixing glass for five seconds. Remove glass from smoke, and slowly turn over. Strain cocktail into smoked glass very slowly. Express orange peel
method: Boil sugar in water. Add crushed cinnamon sticks and let simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat, let cool, and strain into a glass bottle. Refrigerate for up to a month. How to make a smoked cinnamon stickUsing a long lighter or cigar lighter, light the cinnamon stick until glowing red and remove flame.
storyTitle: Smoked Sazerac [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Mix all ingredients together in a punch bowl with eight 2-by-2-inch ice cubes (or 4 cups regular ice cubes). Garnish with lemon wheels, chopped lemongrass, and candied ginger.
ingredients: ½ pound ginger, peeled and finely grated
method: Bring all ingredients to a simmer over medium heat. Stir until sugar and honey dissolve, being sure not to boil. Let cool one hour. Strain through a fine mesh strainer into an airtight container. Keeps in the refrigerator for two weeks.
storyTitle: Smokin' Grass [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker. Turn the temperature to high until punch reaches the desired temperature. Turn the slow cooker down to low to keep the punch warm during the party. Serve in mugs with lemon slices floated on top.
method: Bring all ingredients to a boil in a small saucepan. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. (For milder flavor, remove star anise and simmer 10 minutes more.) Remove from heat and let cool completely. Strain through a sieve into a bowl; discard solids. Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to one month.
storyTitle: Ultimate Hottie Toddy [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Stir all together in a mixing glass. Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube. Twist orange peel over drink to catch oils, then use as garnish.
method: Add sugar and cranberry juice to a blender. Blend on medium-high speed for 2 to 4 minutes, or until all sugar crystals have dissolved. Strain into a container and refrigerate immediately. Will keep up to one week.
storyTitle: The Late Harvest [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Add bourbon, chai syrup, and fruit juices to a shaker. Fill halfway with ice and shake for 5 seconds. Strain into a rocks glass with one big rock. Float red wine on top.
method: Combine water and sugar in a pot over medium heat. Heat until sugar is dissolved. Allow to cool. Add tea bag and refrigerate for 4 hours. Remove tea bag and keep in a sealed container in the fridge for up to a week.
storyTitle: Falling in Love [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine all ingredients in a shaker. Add ice and shake. Strain over fresh ice in a Collins glass. Top with cider and garnish with cinnamon.
method: Bring water to a boil. Add sugar and dissolve. Remove from heat and add cinnamon sticks. Let steep overnight, then strain into a container with a lid. Keep refrigerated for up to two weeks.
storyTitle: Charming Man [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine all ingredients in shaker with ice, shake vigorously, and strain into coupe. Garnish with fanned Granny Smith apple slices.
method: Put water and spices in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes. Slowly add sugar, stirring until dissolved. Remove from heat. Strain through a fine mesh strainer, place in a storage container, and refrigerate for up to 10 days.
storyTitle: An Apple A Day [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Add all ingredients to a glass with ice and stir until chilled. Strain and serve neat in a rocks glass. Garnish with fresh sage leaf. (Optional: On a fireproof surface, make a small pile of dried and fresh sage, half a cinnamon stick, and hay. Light on fire. Extinguish the flame by covering with the rocks glass, and let the glass smoke while you prepare the cocktail.)
ingredients: 4 oz. (1 good handful) organic hay (available at Organic Hay Co. or Baldor Specialty Food)
method: Combine all ingredients and let steep in an airtight container. Stir and taste every day. Steep until smooth on the throat when you swallow, about 7 to 15 days. Strain and transfer into a clean glass container. Keep in the refrigerator for up to two months.
storyTitle: Saged Sherry [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine all ingredients except club soda in a shaker with ice. Shake until chilled. Strain into a Collins glass with ice. Top with soda. Garnish with pear slices.
method: Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan. Simmer until sugar is dissolved. Allow to cool. Strain and store in a glass bottle in the fridge for up to two weeks.
storyTitle: Empire Line [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Combine ingredients in a shaker and dry whip. Add ice and shake hard to chill. Strain into a chilled coupe. Grate dried chipotle across the top.
ingredients: 1 cup corn silk (Rip silks from under the corn husk. You can use fresh silks, or save and dry them.)
¾ cup chestnut honey or other honey
method: On a sheet pan, roast corn silks in a 350 degree oven until brown. Meanwhile, heat cream and chipotles in a small saucepan until very warm, but not yet steaming. When corn silks are browned, submerge in heated cream, cover, and remove from heat. Allow to infuse for about 30 minutes. Strain, discarding silks and chipotles. Add honey to cream and mix well. Store covered in the refrigerator for up to five days.
storyTitle: Corn Silk Flip [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker. Fill the shaker with ice, shake vigorously, and strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice. Garnish with lemon twist.
method: Cut squash in half. Scoop out seeds. Roast, cut side down, in a 350-degree oven for 40 minutes. Let cool, then scoop out flesh. Combine equal parts by weight of flesh, apple cider vinegar, and sugar. Place in refrigerator for 24 hours. Strain through a chinois to separate liquid from solids,discarding solids. Pour liquid into a glass container, shake well, and store in the refrigerator for up to six months to a year.
storyTitle: Batista’s Exile [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Stir all ingredients together in a mixing glass. Strain into a coupe glass and garnish with lemon twist.
method: Combine chamomile, water, sugar, peppercorns, cinnamon, and lemon and orange peels in a medium sauce pan. Bring to a boil about 10 minutes, being sure to dissolve all sugar. Cover and let cool to room temperature. Strain through cheesecloth to remove all solids. Add apple brandy. Keep refrigerated for up to 1 month.
storyTitle: The 11th Commandment [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: In a blender, blend ice cream, whisky, and caramel sauce together until smooth. Pour into a parfait or pint glass and garnish with whipped cream and a drizzle of caramel. Serve with a straw and spoon.
method: In a small saucepan, combine sugar, butter, and ¼ cup water. Make sure the sugar is completely wet; if it’s not, add 1-2 tablespoons water. Over medium heat, bring the mixture to a boil. The sugar and butter will begin to caramelize. When the sugar turns a dark honey color, remove from heat, add cream and salt immediately, and whisk everything together. Be careful, as the mixture will release a lot of hot steam! Pour caramel into a heatproof dish and let cool before using, at least 30 minutes. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month. Makes 2 cups.
storyTitle: Nameshake [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Scoop ice cream into serving glass. Pour infused scotch and syrup into a mixing tin. Add ice and shake. Strain over ice cream and garnish with 1 scoop peach-lemon zest and mint sprig. Note: To make black tea-Infused blended scotch, let a black teabag steep in 4 oz. Dewar’s 12 year old blended scotch (or other blended scotch) for 30-45 minutes, stirring occasionally; then remove.
method: Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. Zest the lemon into water and add 1 cup of sugar. Peel the lemon, discarding the peel and and adding the whole fruit to pan. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved. Add the peach jam and stir to combine over low heat. Let cool completely. When the mixture is at room temperature, strain, separating the liquid and the solids. Keep the liquid refrigerated in a sealed container for 2 weeks.
storyTitle: Southern Scotsman [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: In a Julep cup or rocks glass, pour in whiskey, Brancamenta, cardamom-macademia nut syrup, and cold brew. Fill the cup ¾ of the way with crushed ice, then agitate the whole thing with a bar spoon or swizzler. Top with more crushed ice, dash the bitters, and garnish with a macademia nut or two and a mint sprig. Note: To make cardamom-macademia nut syrup, you need
ingredients: 1 whole orange peel, with most of the pith removed
method: Toast the macadamia nuts at 350 degrees for 7-10 minutes, or until evenly browned. Combine all the ingredients and simmer at low heat until you can taste the macademia nuts in the syrup. Strain, setting aside the nuts for garnish.
storyTitle: Wake & Bake Julep [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Stir all ingredients with ice to dilute. Strain into a Nick and Nora glass. Garnish with edible flowers.
method: In a saucepan, bring water to a boil. Remove from heat, add tea bags, and steep for 3 to 5 minutes. Remove tea bags and stir in sugar to dissolve. Keep refrigerated in an airtight glass container for up to two weeks.
storyTitle: The King is Dead [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: For cinnamon simple syrup:
intro: Combine liquid ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake and strain over fresh ice. Garnish with the cinnamon stick.
method: Combine ingredients over low heat and stir until sugar is dissolved. Cover and simmer for one hour. Strain to remove cinnamon sticks and cool. FROM THE WINTER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Howitzer [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: Oleo Saccharum:
intro: Combine all ingredients. To serve, season large piece of ice with one spray of tobacco tincture, add combined ingredients, and garnish with house-preserved cherry.
ingredients: 1 part citrus peel (i.e. lemon, lime, grapefruit, orange, bergamot)
method: Peel citrus fruit and weigh. In a sealed plastic bag, combine peels with an equal measure of sugar.Press out the air, and seal bag tightly. Massage daily, until all grains of sugar have dissolved and the peels are translucent, approximately five days. Press liquid from solids through cheesecloth or a strainer and refrigerate. Steep Virginia pipe tobacco in white whiskey for 3 days. Strain, and store in an atomizer. Preserve cherries in rhum for 6 months. Remove from liquid. Candy the cherries in demerara sugar. FROM THE WINTER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Stone Soup [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: For honey simple syrup:
intro: Combine liquid ingredients in a mixing glass with ice. Stir and strain into a coupe glass or serve on the rocks. Garnish with a cherry.
method: Over medium heat, add ingredients until honey and sugar are dissolved. Let cool and bottle. Store refrigerated for up to two weeks. Place honey and sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly until sugar is melted and beginning to caramelize. Add vinegar and cherries. Continue to simmer for 30 minutes, or until the liquid reaches a syrup consistency. Adjust to taste. Allow to cool and strain out the cherries, reserving the liquid. Bottle and refrigerate for up to two weeks. FROM THE WINTER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Alpine Skyline [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: For root beer syrup:
intro: In a tall pilsner glass, add Jack Daniel’s and root beer syrup. Top with soda water, leaving enough space for whipped cream. Stir gently and top with whipped cream. Spray with cocktail bitters from an atomizer.
ingredients: ⅓ oz. simple syrup (equal parts water and sugar)
⅔ oz. Zatarain’s Root Beer Concentrate
method: Combine ingredients in a small squeeze bottle. You can create a larger batch to easily make multiple drinks. FROM THE WINTER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Element 47 Root Beer Float [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: To make cinnamon tincture:
intro: Add the liquid ingredients to a mixing glass and stir. Pour into a hot mug. Garnish with a cinnamon stick.
method: Roast cinnamon sticks for 15 minutes in an oven at 400°F or toast them in a pan set over high heat until slightly smoking. Let the sticks cool before handling. Break the cinnamon sticks into 1⁄2-inch pieces and place them in a spice bag or cheesecloth. In a jar add grain alcohol, vodka, or other high-proof neutral spirit with cinnamon to steep for 7–14 days. Remove the cinnamon from the tincture and discard. Store in a cool environment; the tincture can keep for several months. FROM THE WINTER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Western Cider [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: For Pickled Blackberries:
intro: Swizzle all ingredients on crushed ice and garnish with pickled blackberries.
method: Bring sugar and vinegar to simmer with a couple stalks of thyme. Allow to cool then combine with blackberries for no less than 30 days. FROM THE SUMMER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Whiskey Mulberry Shrub [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: For green tea honey syrup:
intro: Serve in a glass fishbowl with crushed ice. Top with ginger beer. Garnish with fresh fruit.
method: Boil water. Add green tea bags. Let steep according to tea instructions. Add honey and stir until dissolved. FROM THE SUMMER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Fish Bowl No. 5 [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: For Pear Cider (makes about 1 liter):
intro: Add first four ingredients into a shaker tin with ice and shake for 15-20 seconds. Double strain into a Collins glass, add Fever Tree ginger beer and top with more ice as needed. Garnish with some fresh pear slices.
method: Juice pears. Add pear juice and spices to a pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer. Let simmer for 20-30 minutes then strain into a clean container. Let cool before using. FROM THE SUMMER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: The Highland [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
credit: For strawberry-mint popsicle:
intro: Add bourbon to a rocks glass and invert a strawberry-mint popsicle in the glass (see below).
method: Cook strawberries over medium heat for about 15 to 20 minutes, until thoroughly melted and becoming thin and consistent in texture. Add sugar and stir until fully dissolved. Remove from heat and puree in a blender until smooth. Add the mint into the puree and refrigerate overnight. After 24 hours, remove the mint and stir the puree. Pour into popsicle molds with a stick and freeze. FROM THE SUMMER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: Strawberry-Mint Poptail [Cocktail Recipe]

name: DIRECTIONS
intro: Build ingredients directly in a short rocks glass over ice. Stir gently and garnish with a charred corn husk.
method: Soak corn in bourbon for 48 hours at room temperature. Strain to remove corn. FROM THE SUMMER 2016 ISSUE.
storyTitle: The Nine Pound Hammer [Cocktail Recipe]
